settings.row_1_text: The cleaning process begins with a thorough inspection and sorting of the garments returned by customers. Our trained professionals meticulously examine each garment to identify any damage, stains, or wear and tear.
settings.row_2_text: Indian luxury garments often feature intricate embroidery, delicate fabrics, and unique embellishments that require specialized attention. Our experienced cleaners employ a range of techniques, including steaming, spot treatment, and dry cleaning.
settings.row_3_text: After the cleaning process, each garment undergoes a meticulous quality control check. Our team ensures that every item meets our stringent standards for cleanliness, appearance, and overall condition. If any repairs are required, they are expertly carried out at this stage.
settings.row_4_text: Our commitment to sustainability extends to reusable, sturdy packaging designed specifically to protect Indian luxury garments during transportation.
